name: NG exhaustion phase-1 causal-executable higher-order protocol
purpose: Separate retrospective structural higher-order chain memory from higher-order behavior that is causally available at the descendant event and therefore potentially executable.

do_not_discard.retrospective_structural_chain: The parent Phase-1 full-path run remains a first-class structural-chain result even when some predecessor aftermath samples finish after the descendant event begins.
do_not_discard.causal_executable_chain: This run is a second structural axis, not a replacement. It asks what chain depth survives using only predecessor behavior already observable by the descendant t0.

input_at_horizon_h.fields: predecessor next-exhaustion same/flip plus predecessor signed displacement, MFE and MAE at every frozen aftermath horizon <= h
input_at_horizon_h.availability_gate: for every predecessor included in a depth-D history, predecessor causal endpoint confirmation + h must be <= descendant event t0; next-same is known no later than the descendant t0 for the immediate predecessor

target.fields: descendant full behavior vector: its next-exhaustion same/flip plus signed displacement, MFE and MAE at 5,10,20,30,60,120,300 seconds
target.role: future behavior to be predicted at descendant t0

depth_comparison.paired_sample_rule: For each D, compare D-history against D-1-history on exactly the same D-eligible training and test targets so sample selection cannot manufacture incremental gain.
depth_comparison.inner_tuning: alternate the two training weeks; no held-out-week tuning

reporting.retrospective_higher_order: reported from parent structural Phase-1 run
reporting.structural_but_not_yet_executable: allowed and preserved when retrospective depth exceeds causal depth
reporting.rolling_vs_inherited: origin-persistence remains a separate axis and is not required for either structural or causal higher-order chain status
